arguments.summary: Credential compromise of service account 'svc_backup_admin' via initial access on endpoint WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). Attack originated from malicious PowerShell execution leading to Cobalt Strike beaconing. Lateral movement attempts observed. Account exhibited anomalous behavior including off-hours access and privilege escalation. Immediate containment actions taken: network isolation, credential reset, endpoint scan, and system hardening.

timeline.description: Initial access via phishing email with malicious PowerShell payload executed by user jsmith on WS-FIN-042.
rundll32.exe launched encoded PowerShell from temp directory; C2 beacon established to 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike beaconing (ET TROJAN signature).
Failed Kerberos TGT requests using brute-force pattern against svc_backup_admin account.
Successful authentication as svc_backup_admin; lateral movement via SMB to file server initiated.
UEBA system flags critical anomaly for svc_backup_admin: unusual login time, geolocation, and access pattern.
Firewall rules deployed to block all traffic to/from 10.0.5.42.
Credentials for svc_backup_admin reset and MFA token revoked.
Full endpoint scan detects exploit (Exploit.CVE-2024-3094) in system library.
Ansible hardening playbook applied to WS-FIN-042 to enforce security baselines.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity"
        tlp = "amber"
        miter_ids = ["T1071.001"]
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $beacon_host = "Host:" wide ascii
        $beacon_useragent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of ($beacon_*)
}
